A nightmare for the socially awkward - a party you cannot go home from until it is over and back in harbor


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/cb8b604cdc89c2df02ed2eb117bcc9141ef45478.png[/img]
You may question the warning about going into the ocean after a large meal, but certainly, it is unwise to go swimming after doing ten shots


This update also includes

[list]
[*] New music track for Beach
[*] New bg skin
[*] New playable deck "Seasonal Visitors" 
[*] New Item "Cold Beverage"
[*] Balance tweaks
[*] UI changes to adjust better to some screens
[*] Better visual feedback from tourists' cards time left
[*] Translation updates

[/list]

[h2]Urban Cards is coming to the Ipad! [/h2]

[b]Join our mailing list here[/b]
http://eepurl.com/ioAS0A

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/94e93e365a415e49a98dab1a1d5d73ae7b0205d2.png[/img]



[h2]The Christmas faction is now a DLC[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361870/Urban_Cards_Christmas_Faction/


And that's all for tonight,
Thanks for playing!
Daniel

notes.title: Controller Support and News
notes.content:
Hey hey, people!

It´s been a while but we are still here working on improving and extending Urban Cards.

[h2]NEW FACTION COMING![/h2]
After thinking about many new ideas and prototypes, we've decided to keep working on our beloved Urban Cards and to finally announce a new neighborhood:
Introducing [b]Beach[/b]

[i]By the rising seas. Tourists descend like a swarm of bright pink locusts,  ready to squeeze the last drop of forgetfulness and fleeting pleasure from the hours purchased in advance. They lose their minds and their wallets, while the locals smile indulgently. Beaches bright like glitter, golden tans and the pallor of salmonella.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/b351b20b3aac5d26928d3bff01e42831c8473482.jpg[/img]
This faction will be available soon after finishing our port to Switch. Stay tuned for news and help us test it! 

[h2]Patch Notes [/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Controller support[/b] Yes! It took some time but we finally have controller support. 
[*][b]Optimized the way the game loads textures. [/b]Now the game works on older systems with less memory by having a low-rez version of the textures. 
[*] Tweaked Restaurants PvP deck to make it more competitive. 
[*] Now you can play [b]PvP against BOTS.[/b] Just click the JOIN button and select one of the BOTS. This way you can practice and try decks to later use against other players.
[*] Reduced Hackers Boss difficulty. Also, hackers don't have [b]Stolen Credit Card[/b]  item anymore
[/list]

[h2]What else have we been up to?[/h2]

We have been working hard on the [b]port to the Switch[/b] as well as testing some other tools like Unreal Engine that has helped us prototype a few game concepts like Urban Karts. This is[b] just an idea[/b] but we wanted to share this poster with you guys and see if you dig the idea of a racing game with an economic component within the Urban Cards universe. Let us know what you think in the comments :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/0143086e83f46a9310cfa32beb36149639b8f8b9.jpg[/img]

And that's it! Shoutout to our beloved discord users that have given us many ideas and motivation to keep expanding the game. THANKS, GUYS!

notes.title: Road to 1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Trading Cards
[/h2]
Maybe you were asking yourself, how can a card game not have steam trading cards?? So here we go! We have added 8 trading cards,  6 Badges, 5 steam profile backgrounds (3 common, 1 uncommon, and 1 rare), and 5 Icons to use on the steam chat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/759a8900f479e7e9f26f8faaa9fc32ab12f87f8a.png[/img]

[h2]Road to 1.0 [/h2]
Here are some thoughts and background story I wanted to share with you guys, our goals and objectives moving forward to 1.0.

First off I want to talk a bit about our backgrounds and about how Urban Cards was conceived. We are a team of two ppl: myself, [url=https://www.instagram.com/danieltapiart/]Daniel Tapia[/url], creator, designer, and artist wearing many different hats. And my friend Arturo Cepeda, the guy behind the technology and mechanisms that make the game run smoothly. We met while working in a German company that makes AAA games and we became friends. At some point and after a few Weizenbiers, we started fantasizing about the idea of going just a little indie and making our own original little games. In our free time. Just for fun.

After that, I moved to the west coast of Canada to work in the film industry for big Hollywood productions. And after working on many superhero movies I realized that what I really wanted to do was to start building something of my own. 
I started working on a physical version of the game about 5 years ago, with the idea of creating a distinguishable and unique card battler that let the players fight for money in a competitive and unfair satirized world. 
The main idea was to have players compete for money rather than killing the opponent physically. So the main victory condition was there. 
At the time I met a lot of people in North America with huge student loan debt so I thought it would be an interesting idea to have something persistent like that in the game as a secondary victory condition.

So things started to look interesting and promising and I quit my day job to release the Early Acces and to have more time to organize the project. During this time, I became a dad, so things got busier. <3 Parenting and going full indie at the same time was quite scary but we managed to make it work and we released the Early Access. And now it's time to launch 1.0.

We are planning to release the full game around Jan/Feb 2021, adding new cards (around ~15) and content, a History menu that stores past runs data, and other things. We also want to polish PvP and the campaign a bit more. With the addition of new cards and enemies, we think the game will be a lot more replayable. 
Here's a sample of the new cards coming along with the remodeling of some of the BIZ
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/25f56af2ea4ec494dc54272cd93b931c127a5ca8.png[/img]

[h2]Localization[/h2]

Adding more languages is also on our list. We actually have just added [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] to the game!!. This way we can hopefully reach more people and keep supporting the game in the long run.  
[b][url=https://www.localizor.com/urban-cards]Localizor [/url][/b]has been great for us to let the community help with this massive task. 

[h2]Patch Notes 
[/h2]
Exposed the V-Sync setting in the options menu
Added chat to PvP
Integrating the quickmatch interface in the lobby scene and polished it in general
Showing the player's ranking when finishing a game
Representing remote card inspection
Fixing the bug that caused the AI to stop playing when "Gun Control" was used on "Employee of the Month"

Debt is not accumulated when leaving the game

—Gastown Dealer[/i]

notes.title: Multiplayer 🎉
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/702ae176a5dde3735cc4246e7ab96b35b04b1360.jpg[/img]
Now you can finally challenge friends and strangers to soar with you to the heights of greed and ingenuity and to wallow in the basest mud of sabotage and dirty capitalism.

We have released the first version of the PvP, so you can now show off your business acumen to other players in real-time! 

The multiplayer version includes 9 playable decks with every card unlocked regardless of your level.  I'll be balancing them periodically so don't hesitate to give us your feedback.
This is a first iteration and there are things to improve and features to add [spoiler]like a multiplayer leaderboard[/spoiler] and we'll keep tweaking it with your help. 



[h2]Help us translate the game[/h2]
[url=https://www.localizor.com/urban-cards][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/418118389a3fe0b5cad077f55eea96463ea30922.jpg[/img][/url]
We're looking for fans who want to help translate Urban Cards into their native language. Levels of commitment and time investment are very flexible, if you spend half an hour on it you have already contributed!

For this, we have added the game to Localizor. Localizor is a platform we love where devs can work with communities to translate the game into other languages. 

How can you help?

[list]
[*] Head on over to the [url=https://www.localizor.com/urban-cards]Localizor [/url]platform and sign up
[*] Select a game you want to translate (preferably Urban Cards but there are a few other projects available as well)
[*] Get busy translating! You can either submit a suggestion or vote for existing translations. All the text has been previously translated by google translate. So there is already a basic translation for every string
[*] If you haven't bought the game yet but are interested in helping out, please email or ping me and I'd be happy to provide a key.
[/list]

[h2]Balance
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Nina now costs 600 debt and adds 600 debt to the enemy. She also earns $200
[*] Lady Pigeon costs $600 and 300 debt and has 3 attack
[*] Many other minor tweaks
[/list]

[h2]Help us with your review[/h2]
We encourage people to leave a review of the game, whether good or bad your opinion counts. This way the game will be visible to more people due to algorithm magic. Our core team is just 2 people so any help boosting the visibility of Urban Cards is appreciated.

Love.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3.4 Random Deck
notes.content:
Hey sharks!
We are happy to announce that we have added a new Random deck to each class.
It gets generated procedurally  with a random set of 11 cards from that neighborhood. This is how it works:

We add 3 copies of every unlocked Silver card and 2 copies of every unlocked Gold card into a pool. Then, we randomly pick 2 to 3 Biz, 2 to 3 Workers, 2 to 3 Henchmen and 2 to 3 Actions/Objects totaling 11 cards. 
If the script selects 3 biz, 2 of them will be the same.

We've been trying this deck and it's fun! The amount of possible permutations  expand the ability to create new, crazy strategies. 

Also, now every starter deck has a suitable Special Object from the beginning that provides a small advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/7ffec593eb7fe26c59812045b29b80479ed8b05c.png[/img]


We have also added an "Income" number to the players' screen. So now you know how much you and your opponent will earn in the next turn. 
We included the amount of cards already played, the new hood is going to have some synergies with this number and we wanted to have it visible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35576419/b86b0338d8cfddb6f3b963060081f9ee38b09569.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added Special Objects to every starter deck
[*] Added 3 new special objects, Instant Ramen, Loaded Dice and Fire Alarm
[*] Added 1 grey card "Grant"
[*] Balanced After hours Biz. It costs less but has less defense.

[*] Balanced some prices for the objects
[*] Scaled some low rez textures

[/list]

And that's all, see you next week with more updates!

Your devs,
Daniel & Arturo

notes.title: Urban Cards: First Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!
We are going to start making announcements with updates, bug fixes and more!
Our small team of 2 have been working hard to develop a unique card game for more than 2 years (for me actually more than 4!) and now we are getting closer to Early Access.

Here’s the list of improvements for this build

-Enemy deck changes
Enemy decks on the campaign have Images now so you have the ability to know which neighbourhoods you will be competing against. They also have the money goal for that stage and the number of cards that you can get after winning a stage. (loot) 
We think this improves the ability to make a choice between different “compete”challenges.

Changes to cards
-Condominium now increases its income by 100 when there are 2 henchmen on its street
-Loot cards are now randomized regardless of what you have in your deck. Before, the loot never gave cards that were already in the deck.

Sounds
Added 26 more sounds

UI and more
-Cards in player’s hand have been moved down a bit to better see the workers
-Arrow model scaled down, less prominent.
-Floating numbers indicating earnings tweaked and slightly animated.
-Message box title fixed and texture replaced. 

That’s all folks! We’ll keep working hard to deliver the game early next year.
Follow us for news and more. We have thrilling surprises coming.  

Daniel
